clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram Strand, Naga threaten the Horde's hold on Ashenvale's coast. From Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai seeks to drive the Wrathtail away from the sunken ruins of ancient Zoram.

The Horde's hold on Zoram Strand is fragile. Hostile night elf territory and bitter woodland fighting surround the outpost, whose coast links the Horde to the sea. Aggressive naga have now crawled ashore. They could cut off that link and overwhelm the small garrison before its defenses are ready.

Zoram Strand's sandy shoals hide the shattered remains of Zoram, an ancient elven city swallowed by the Great Sundering thousands of years ago. Marukai and the outpost's defenders do not know why the Wrathtail have come out of the deep trenches now. Their sudden interest in the sunken ruins threatens anyone walking above them.

Marukai sees a simple fight for survival. With swords and tridents drawn, reason matters little. She demands twenty severed heads from the Wrathtail, hoping force will drive the naga back into the depths and secure the shore for the Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is evil lurking here along the coast, traveler.
It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas. Lost, and nearly forgotten.
Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.
Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The naga increase in numbers, friend. Please complete this task for me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We could use more of your kind around here, friend. Thank you for your help.
